what_is_closed: A source-family triage distinguishes the existing sound-derived calibration and J02 comparator from two follow-up experimental routes; no new source is admitted as an independent validation set.
equation_or_mapping: alpha_Phi_K uses d_T(rho_s/rho) near 1.7 K; a second-sound velocity comparison additionally requires an admitted two-fluid response operator, matched state and measurement protocol.
units: calibration: K per normalized base Phi; response: m s^-1; source temperature: K
derivation_class: manual primary-source and reference-table provenance screen
observable: He-II superfluid fraction and second-sound phase velocity at saturated vapor pressure

underlying_studies: Tam and Ahlers (1987), J. Low Temp. Phys. 66, 173
calibration_source_family.method: superfluid density inferred from second- and fourth-sound measurements

routes.reason: Recommended spline mixes input studies and was seen during protocol design; Section 2 calibration has sound-derived ancestry.

routes.locator: Donnelly and Barenghi (1998), Table 4.1 key 1; Heiserman, Hulin, Maynard and Rudnick, Phys. Rev. B 14, 3862 (1976), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.14.3862
routes.reason: The primary abstract reports simultaneous first-, second- and fourth-sound measurements; Maynard is a coauthor of the key-1 study and the author of the sound-derived thermodynamic study used by Section 2. Exact row reuse remains unverified.

routes.locator: Donnelly and Barenghi (1998), Section 2 key 3 and Section 4 Table 4.1 key 3
routes.reason: The same named study family contributes to calibration and second-sound compilation.

routes.locator: Dash and Taylor, Phys. Rev. 105, 7-24 (1957), DOI 10.1103/PhysRev.105.7
routes.method: Andronikashvili-type oscillating disks, normal-fluid density and viscosity

routes.reason: The primary abstract establishes a non-sound measurement method in the relevant temperature range, but not a usable numeric calibration package; scale conversion and instrument-model uncertainties remain open.

claim_boundary: Separate study names and Table 4.1 keys are source-route evidence, not statistical independence, physical prediction, holdout integrity or Full Topic 13 closure. No experimental row is admitted or fitted.
